## Pembaruan UI & Tata Letak Sabit v1.1.1

### Perbaikan Tata Letak Toolbar & Sidebar
- **Pemilih Model AI Dipindahkan ke Settings (`Hardware & AI`)**: Dropdown model `YOLOv8s` / `YOLOv8n` kini ditempatkan secara rapi di `File -> Settings -> Hardware & AI` sehingga toolbar utama kembali bersih dan tombol `Snapshot` serta kontrol `AI Sensor` tampil utuh tanpa tumpang tindih.
- **Posisi Baru `Live Histogram` di Atas `System Log`**: Kartu `Live Histogram` kini berada tepat di atas `System Log` sehingga panel `Astronomy and Ephemeris` serta kontrol kamera langsung terlihat rapi di bagian atas sidebar.
- **Anti-Terpotong pada Sidebar Kanan**: Lebar minimum sidebar ditingkatkan dan `MarqueeLabel` (tanggal Hijriah, status visibilitas, info driver) dibatasi proporsional agar tombol `Location`, `LX Mode`, dan `Auto` tidak terpotong di sisi kanan.

### Fitur Dual-Model AI (`HILAL-DETECT V2`)
- **Model Utama `YOLOv8s` (`conf=0.30`) & `YOLOv8n` (`conf=0.75`)**: Tetap mendukung pergantian model real-time tanpa restart saat konfigurasi disimpan di Settings.

## Sabit v1.1.1 UI & Layout Revision

### Toolbar & Sidebar Layout Polish
- **AI Model Selector Moved to `Settings -> Hardware & AI`**: Moved the `YOLOv8s` / `YOLOv8n` dropdown out of the top toolbar into `File -> Settings -> Hardware & AI` so the main toolbar stays compact with unclipped `Snapshot` and `AI Sensor` controls.
- **Repositioned `Live Histogram` Above `System Log`**: Moved `Live Histogram` directly above `System Log`, keeping `Astronomy and Ephemeris` and camera controls clean at the top of the Observation Controls sidebar.
- **Right-Sidebar Clipping Fixes**: Widened minimum sidebar width and prevented `MarqueeLabel` text expansion from clipping `Location`, `LX Mode`, and `Auto` controls.

### Dual-Model AI (`HILAL-DETECT V2`)
- **Primary `YOLOv8s` (`conf=0.30`) & `YOLOv8n` (`conf=0.75`)**: Runtime model switching without restart remains active whenever changed from Settings.
